div.div: Why two stacks and not one: the Helm provider needs the cluster endpoint at plan time, so Cilium and Flux cannot be planned in the same apply that creates the cluster. Stage 1 brings nodes Ready on VPC-CNI; Stage 2 deletes it and hands networking to Cilium.

text.tspan: Why two stacks and not one: the Helm provider needs the cluster endpoint at plan time, so Cilium and Flux cannot be planned in the same apply that creates the cluster.
Stage 1 brings nodes Ready on VPC-CNI; Stage 2 deletes it and hands networking to Cilium.
